Software should help a business move as one. Our platform brings together people, AI, data, and workflows so IT and service teams can anticipate what matters, act faster, and keep the business moving forward together. Organizations including Bridgestone, McLaren, New Balance, S&P Global, and Sony Music trust Freshworks to power the services their employees and customers depend on every day.  We bring that same belief in coordinated action to how we work by giving people the ownership to make bold moves at speed, and a team that moves with them.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are looking for a highly motivated, results-driven Senior Account Executive to accelerate Freshworks' growth across Southern Brazil, covering Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul.

The ideal candidate will bring deep regional market knowledge, an established professional network, and a proven track record of acquiring new customers and expanding strategic accounts within the SaaS and enterprise technology ecosystem.

This role requires a strong Hunter mindset, combined with the relationship-building and account-development capabilities of a successful Farmer.

The successful candidate will be responsible for building a sustainable business across the territory, developing executive relationships, generating new business opportunities, and maximizing revenue growth within existing accounts.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Development – Hunter

  • Drive new logo acquisition across Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul.
  • Proactively identify, prospect, and develop opportunities within Mid-Market and Enterprise accounts.
  • Leverage an established regional network to accelerate engagement with strategic prospects and key decision-makers.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with CIOs, CTOs, IT Directors, Customer Experience leaders, and other C-level executives.
  • Own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and closing.
  • Develop and execute territory and account plans to consistently achieve revenue and new business targets.

Account Management & Expansion – Farmer

  • Build long-term strategic relationships with existing Freshworks customers across the assigned territory.
  • Identify and execute upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities.
  • Expand Freshworks' footprint through additional products, business units, and use cases.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success and other internal teams to maximize customer value, adoption, retention, and growth.
  • Develop executive sponsorship and multilevel relationships within strategic accounts.

Territory & Partner Development

  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of the Southern Brazilian business environment, including regional industries, enterprise accounts, and key economic groups.
  • Establish and strengthen relationships with local technology partners, system integrators, and channel organizations.
  • Develop joint go-to-market initiatives with regional partners to generate qualified pipeline and accelerate revenue.
  • Identify high-potential accounts and market segments, creating a sustainable territory development strategy.

Sales Execution & Forecasting

  • Consistently achieve or exceed sales quotas for new business and account expansion.
  • Maintain a healthy, qualified, and predictable sales pipeline.
  • Provide accurate forecasts and maintain disciplined CRM hygiene.
  • Apply consultative and value-based selling methodologies to articulate business outcomes and return on investment.
  • Collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Channel Sales, Customer Success, and leadership to execute strategic opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience in B2B enterprise SaaS sales or related IT solutions.
  • Strong professional experience selling into Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul, with an established regional customer and partner network.
  • Demonstrated success in new logo acquisition, territory development, and strategic account expansion.
  • Proven ability to operate as both a Hunter and Farmer, balancing proactive business development with long-term account growth.
  • Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and executive-level decision-makers.
  • Strong negotiation, business development, and executive relationship management skills.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise sales processes, pipeline management, and forecasting.
  • Fluent Portuguese and professional proficiency in English.
  • Based in Southern Brazil, with availability for frequent travel throughout the assigned territory.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Experience selling enterprise IT solutions within the Brazilian technology ecosystem.
  • Established relationships with CIOs, IT leaders, CX executives, and technology partners across Southern Brazil.
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale, or Value Selling.
  • Experience working in global technology companies and partner-led sales environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent achievement of new business and expansion revenue targets.
  • Strong pipeline generation and new customer acquisition across all three states.
  • Increased wallet share and product penetration within existing accounts.
  • Development of a strong network of executive relationships and regional channel partners.
  • Predictable sales execution, accurate forecasting, and sustainable territory growth.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text: At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.
